stage: After headers; before numerical calibration inspection
purpose: Qualify the separately measured calibration, without fitting a cost curve or opening community observations
source_basis: Ghedini et al. 2020 methods identify separate monoculture assays from Malerba et al. 2017. The named sheet has species, dilution, volume, calibration cell counts and oxygen rates.
allowed: Decode only the named calibration worksheet and its referenced shared strings
Retain rows, cell references, missingness and primitive types in columns A:I
Describe species, light and dilution coverage, replication labels and size support
Check supplied per-cell rates against bulk oxygen rate divided by calibration cell number
Describe signs and missing values; do not discard observations to obtain positive costs
stop_conditions: A formula occurs in selected data cells: establish dependencies before interpreting its cached value
Unknown units or source linkage: do not guess calibration meaning
No independent size-bin observation bridge: do not substitute taxon means for measured size distributions
deferred: Any power or non-power fitting, bin selection, discrimination threshold or community forecast requires a separate numerical protocol
Community sheets and all other workbook contents remain unopened
No law score, no new registered empirical study, no claim that published summaries were unseen
